defaults.title: Agency defaults
defaults.intro: These apply to every position and every recruiter in your agency.
defaults.readOnly: Only an admin can change these.

weights.title: Matching weights
weights.intro: How much each area counts in the match score. They must add up to 100. Recruiters can change them for one position.
weights.sumError: The weights must add up to 100 (now {sum}).

outreach.title: Outreach timing
outreach.second: Days from the first message to the follow-up
outreach.third: Days from the follow-up to the final follow-up
outreach.recent: Warn if a candidate was contacted in the last N days (0 turns the warning off)

guards.title: Rules before important steps
guards.intro: Block stops the step. Warn lets the recruiter continue after seeing the warning.

keys.jdApproval: Moving a position to sourcing without an approved job description
keys.resumeApproval: Submitting without the candidate's approved resume
keys.consent: Submitting without the candidate's consent for this client
keys.recruiterAssessment: Submitting without the recruiter's own assessment

reasons.title: Rejection reasons
reasons.label: One reason per line
reasons.hint: Shown when a candidate is rejected or withdraws. 1 to 30 different reasons.
reasons.error: Enter 1 to 30 different reasons, each 2 to 60 characters.

language.label: Default language
language.hint: Used for people who have not chosen their own.

defaults.failed: Could not save. Check the values and try again.

explainOnly.label: Explain-only mode
explainOnly.hint: Show how well a candidate matches in words and evidence, and hide the numeric scores. Candidates are still listed in the suggested review order.

level.over: Budget used: AI drafting is paused, everything else keeps working

outbox.title: Outbox
outbox.intro: Every email the app sent or captured. With the test transport, messages stay here instead of being delivered.

privacy.title: Privacy requests
privacy.intro: Candidates can ask for a copy of their data or for it to be deleted. Record the request here, and carry it out before the deadline.
privacy.started: Started. This can take a few minutes.
privacy.confirmDelete: This permanently removes the candidate's personal data and files. Pipeline stages and counts are kept. It cannot be undone.
privacy.adminOnly: Only an admin can carry out or decline a request.
privacy.error: Could not complete that. Try again.

branding.title: Branding
branding.intro: Your name, colour and logo appear on PDFs, Word files, the hiring manager and candidate portals, and the emails they receive.
branding.readOnly: Only an admin can change these.
branding.displayName: Name shown to clients and candidates
branding.colorHint: A hex colour like #1f2937, dark enough to read on white.
branding.colorError: Use a hex colour like #1f2937 that is dark enough to read on white.
branding.failed: This could not be saved. Try again.

logo.title: Logo
logo.intro: A PNG or JPEG, up to 512 KB and 4000 pixels on a side.
logo.tooLarge: The logo can be at most 512 KB.
logo.wrongType: Upload a PNG or JPEG image.
logo.tooManyPixels: The logo can be at most 4000 pixels wide or high.

preview.title: Preview
preview.sample: How the header of a document looks

support.title: Support access
support.intro: Team of Wakers support can look into your workspace only if you approve a request here. Access is read-only, ends on its own (at most 72 hours) and you can revoke it at any time.
support.failed: This could not be saved. The request may already have been answered.

views.title: What support has looked at
views.intro: Every page or data request made under a grant is listed here and in the activity log.

export.title: Data export
export.intro: A ZIP of everything your agency holds in EaseMuse: every table as JSON lines and every stored file, with a README that explains the format. It can take a few minutes. The last two exports are kept.
export.busy: An export is already being prepared.
export.failed: The export could not be made. Try again, or contact support.
export.tooLarge: There is too much data for one export. Contact support and we will prepare it for you.

billing.title: Plan and seats
billing.intro: Your plan, how many seats you use, this month's AI use and your invoices. To change your plan, contact Team of Wakers.
billing.notConnected: Billing is not connected yet, so there is no plan or invoice to show. Everything else keeps working.

plan.title: Plan
plan.none: No plan has been assigned yet.
plan.stale: Billing could not be read just now. This is the last plan we know.

seats.title: Seats
seats.noLimit: {active} seats in use. Your plan sets no limit.
seats.pending: {count, plural, one {# invitation is open and holds a seat.} other {# invitations are open and hold seats.}}
seats.full: No free seat: switch someone off or cancel an invitation to invite another person.

usage.title: AI use in {month}
usage.reported: Reported for billing: {cents} cents. Last report {when}.
usage.failed: {count, plural, one {# report to Billing has not gone through yet and will be sent again.} other {# reports to Billing have not gone through yet and will be sent again.}}

invoices.title: Invoices
invoices.unavailable: Invoices could not be loaded just now.
